fusions.name: Ink Burst
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of ink into the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage and bursting for 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Quad Spurt
fusions.desc: Looses 4 jets of water in a spread, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Jet Away
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward in a burst.

fusions.name: Many Arms
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, an arm lashes the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 6 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
